newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks fall in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks fall in thin trade.

text.p: Croatian stocks fell on Friday, ending a poorly traded week.
* Five of 10 traded issues fell, only one rose and four were flat.
* Volume dwindled to 1,182 units, turnover to 0.8 million kuna.
* Food stock Podravka, down six kuna or 1.5 percent to 189 kuna on volume of 132 shares, led the day's decliners.
* Blue chip Pliva pharmaceuticals was the only gainer, adding 10 kuna to 460. With 275 shares it was the most actively traded issue.
* The other top bracket issue, Zagrebacka Banka ordinary stock, edged down 0.10 kuna to 1,850 with 220 units sold. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
